learnings: Bazel Rust builds will fail if a `mod` is declared twice, even if one is conditional.
When adding API routes in Axum, ensure parenthesis mapping when chaining `.nest()` and `.route_layer()` is exact.
Playwright API tests must assert specific HTTP status codes rather than numeric inequalities like `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(200)` to accurately capture 4xx or 5xx failures.
